constraints: If newString is an empty string, each occurrence of oldString in source is deleted.
If oldString is an empty string, the unchanged source is returned.
By default (without *), comparisons are linguistic (accent/diacritic-insensitive, e.g. a=A, a=à, æ=ae) and ignore characters with code < 9.

Passing * as the last parameter switches to character-code-based comparison (case- and accent-sensitive), needed to match special delimiter characters (e.g. Char(1)) or to force case/accent sensitivity; this mode does not account for variant word spellings.

discriminatedBy.rule: Presence of the trailing literal '*' switches the comparison mode used to find oldString from linguistic (default) to character-code-based.
